India to Play First T20I Against West Indies in Indore

Team India is set to play its first-ever T20 International match against the West Indies in Indore. The match will be held at the Holkar Stadium. Information regarding past matches at the venue is also being highlighted. Arrangements for parking vehicles have been made at Pancham Ki Fail, SGSITS, and Bal Vinay Mandir for the event.
